outcomes.title: Community resilience is strengthened through disaster experience
outcomes.description: The community has used the disaster experience as a catalyst to strengthen its overall resilience, including improved social networks, enhanced preparedness, and greater capacity to withstand future shocks.

activities.title: Conduct community resilience assessments
activities.description: Undertake baseline and periodic resilience assessments across affected communities to identify strengths, gaps, and opportunities for building long-term resilience capacity.

activities.title: Facilitate community-led resilience planning workshops
activities.description: Bring together diverse community members to co-design resilience plans that build on local knowledge, strengths, and social capital developed during and after the disaster.

activities.title: Establish community resilience hubs
activities.description: Create physical or virtual hubs where community members can access resilience-building resources, connect with support services, and participate in preparedness activities.

indicators.title: Community resilience index score
indicators.description: Composite score measuring community resilience across multiple dimensions including social capital, economic diversity, infrastructure robustness, and institutional capacity.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Validated community resilience survey instrument administered at baseline and 6-monthly intervals to a representative sample of community members.

indicators.title: Proportion of community members reporting increased confidence in managing future disasters
indicators.description: Percentage of surveyed community members who report feeling more confident in their ability to prepare for, respond to, and recover from future disaster events.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Community survey using Likert-scale confidence questions, administered annually to a stratified random sample of disaster-affected residents.

indicators.title: Evidence of community-driven resilience initiatives
indicators.description: Documented examples of community-initiated projects and programs that demonstrate enhanced resilience thinking and practice beyond pre-disaster levels.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Qualitative case studies and community asset mapping, supplemented by key informant interviews with community leaders and recovery coordinators.

indicators.title: Number of active community resilience plans
indicators.description: Count of formally adopted community resilience plans that have been developed or updated as a result of the disaster recovery process.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Administrative records review of local government and community organisation planning documents, verified through stakeholder consultation.

outcomes.title: Community can sustain and manage own recovery
outcomes.description: The affected community has developed sufficient capacity, resources, and governance structures to manage its ongoing recovery independently, without continued reliance on external recovery support.

activities.title: Develop community-owned recovery transition plans
activities.description: Work with communities to create structured transition plans that progressively transfer recovery management responsibility from external agencies to local organisations and community groups.

activities.title: Build local capacity for ongoing recovery management
activities.description: Provide training, mentoring, and resources to local leaders, community organisations, and council staff to ensure they can sustain recovery efforts after external support is withdrawn.

activities.title: Establish sustainable funding and resource mechanisms
activities.description: Identify and secure ongoing funding sources and resource arrangements that support continued recovery activities beyond the initial recovery program timeframe.

indicators.title: Proportion of recovery functions transitioned to community management
indicators.description: Percentage of recovery program functions that have been successfully handed over to local organisations, community groups, or mainstream service providers.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Recovery program transition tracking register, with quarterly assessments of handover status for each recovery function and service area.

indicators.title: Community self-assessed recovery management capacity
indicators.description: Community leaders and organisations self-assessed readiness to manage recovery independently, covering governance, resources, skills, and knowledge domains.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Structured self-assessment tool completed by community recovery committees and local government recovery teams at quarterly intervals.

indicators.title: Sustained recovery activity levels post external support
indicators.description: Evidence that recovery activities, services, and community initiatives continue at appropriate levels after the withdrawal of external recovery support programs.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Longitudinal monitoring of recovery service delivery data and community activity levels, collected through service provider reports and community observation at 6, 12, and 24 months post-transition.

outcomes.title: Whole-of-community approach to recovery
outcomes.description: Recovery planning and implementation genuinely engages all sectors of the community, including government, business, non-government organisations, and community members, ensuring diverse perspectives and shared ownership.

activities.title: Establish multi-sector recovery partnerships
activities.description: Create formal and informal partnerships across government agencies, businesses, NGOs, and community groups to ensure coordinated and comprehensive recovery efforts.

activities.title: Implement inclusive community engagement processes
activities.description: Design and deliver community engagement activities that deliberately reach and include diverse population groups, ensuring marginalised and hard-to-reach voices are heard in recovery planning.

activities.title: Develop shared recovery vision and priorities
activities.description: Facilitate community-wide processes to develop a shared vision for recovery that reflects the aspirations and priorities of all community sectors and population groups.

indicators.title: Diversity of stakeholders engaged in recovery planning
indicators.description: Measurement of the range and representativeness of stakeholders actively participating in recovery planning and decision-making processes.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Stakeholder engagement tracking database recording participation by sector, demographics, and geographic location across all recovery planning activities.

indicators.title: Community satisfaction with engagement in recovery
indicators.description: Level of satisfaction among community members regarding their opportunity to participate in and influence recovery decisions and activities.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Community satisfaction survey administered biannually, using validated engagement quality measures and open-ended feedback questions.

indicators.title: Evidence of cross-sector collaboration in recovery activities
indicators.description: Documented instances where government, business, NGO, and community actors have jointly planned, funded, or delivered recovery activities.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Review of recovery project documentation, partnership agreements, and meeting minutes to identify and catalogue cross-sector collaborative initiatives.

outcomes.title: Adaptive capacity of community enhanced
outcomes.description: The community has strengthened its ability to adapt to changing circumstances, learn from experience, and adjust its recovery strategies in response to emerging challenges and opportunities.

activities.title: Implement adaptive recovery management frameworks
activities.description: Adopt recovery management approaches that enable regular review and adjustment of strategies based on monitoring data, community feedback, and changing conditions.

activities.title: Facilitate community learning and knowledge sharing
activities.description: Create opportunities for community members and organisations to share experiences, learn from each other, and develop collective knowledge about effective recovery practices.

activities.title: Support innovation and experimentation in recovery
activities.description: Encourage and resource innovative approaches to recovery challenges, allowing communities to trial new solutions and scale successful initiatives.

indicators.title: Frequency and quality of recovery strategy adjustments
indicators.description: Number and significance of adjustments made to recovery plans and strategies in response to monitoring data, evaluation findings, or changed circumstances.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Recovery program management records review, documenting strategy adjustments with supporting rationale and evidence base at quarterly review points.

indicators.title: Community adaptive capacity self-assessment
indicators.description: Community-assessed capacity to identify, evaluate, and respond to changing recovery needs and emerging challenges using structured assessment tools.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Adaptive capacity assessment tool administered to community recovery committees and key stakeholder groups at 6-monthly intervals.

indicators.title: Number of lessons learned captured and applied
indicators.description: Count of formally documented lessons from recovery activities that have been incorporated into revised plans, policies, or practices.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Lessons learned register maintained by recovery program management, with verification of implementation through policy and procedure document review.

outcomes.title: Connectedness and social cohesion restored or enhanced
outcomes.description: Social connections, trust, and cohesion within the community have been restored to at least pre-disaster levels or have been strengthened through shared recovery experiences and collaborative action.

activities.title: Support community gathering and social connection events
activities.description: Fund and facilitate regular community events, gatherings, and activities that bring people together, rebuild social networks, and strengthen community bonds.

activities.title: Strengthen neighbourhood and community group networks
activities.description: Invest in rebuilding and enhancing neighbourhood networks and community group connections that were disrupted by the disaster, including support for new groups formed during recovery.

indicators.title: Community connectedness and social capital index
indicators.description: Composite measure of social connectedness covering trust, belonging, participation in community activities, and strength of social networks.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Social capital survey using validated instruments administered at baseline and annually, with results benchmarked against pre-disaster and comparable community data.

indicators.title: Level of community participation in collective activities
indicators.description: Rate of community member participation in organised community events, volunteer activities, and group-based recovery initiatives.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Event attendance records, volunteer registration databases, and community group membership data collected and aggregated quarterly.

indicators.title: Community perceptions of social cohesion
indicators.description: Community members' subjective assessment of trust, mutual support, and sense of belonging within their neighbourhood and broader community.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Focus groups and community perception surveys conducted biannually with diverse cross-sections of the affected population.

outcomes.title: Effective recovery governance structures in place
outcomes.description: Clear, transparent, and accountable governance arrangements are established for recovery that enable timely decision-making, appropriate resource allocation, and meaningful community participation.

activities.title: Establish clear recovery governance framework
activities.description: Define and implement governance structures with clear roles, responsibilities, decision-making authority, and accountability mechanisms for all recovery stakeholders.

activities.title: Implement transparent reporting and accountability mechanisms
activities.description: Establish regular public reporting on recovery progress, expenditure, and outcomes to ensure transparency and maintain community trust in recovery governance.

activities.title: Ensure community representation in governance
activities.description: Include community representatives in recovery governance structures and decision-making bodies to ensure local knowledge and community priorities inform recovery direction.

indicators.title: Governance effectiveness assessment score
indicators.description: Assessment of recovery governance effectiveness covering clarity of roles, timeliness of decisions, stakeholder satisfaction, and accountability measures.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Governance effectiveness review conducted quarterly using a structured assessment framework, incorporating stakeholder surveys and governance document review.

indicators.title: Timeliness of recovery decision-making
indicators.description: Measurement of the time taken to make and implement key recovery decisions relative to established benchmarks and community expectations.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Decision-making audit tracking key decisions from initiation to implementation, with timeliness benchmarked against recovery program milestones.

indicators.title: Community trust in recovery governance
indicators.description: Level of trust and confidence expressed by community members in the governance arrangements managing disaster recovery in their area.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Community trust survey administered biannually, supplemented by analysis of complaints, feedback, and public submissions related to recovery governance.

outcomes.title: Improved risk awareness and disaster preparedness
outcomes.description: Community members and organisations have a significantly improved understanding of natural hazard risks and have taken practical steps to enhance their preparedness for future disaster events.

activities.title: Deliver community disaster preparedness education programs
activities.description: Implement targeted education and awareness campaigns that help community members understand local hazard risks and take practical preparedness actions for their households and businesses.

activities.title: Update community emergency and risk management plans
activities.description: Review and update local emergency management plans incorporating lessons learned from the disaster, revised risk assessments, and improved response and recovery arrangements.

activities.title: Support community-based emergency preparedness initiatives
activities.description: Fund and facilitate community-led preparedness programs including neighbourhood preparedness groups, community emergency response teams, and disaster ready programs.

indicators.title: Community hazard risk awareness levels
indicators.description: Proportion of community members who can accurately identify local hazard risks and describe appropriate preparedness and response actions.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Risk awareness survey administered to representative community sample at baseline and annually, testing knowledge of local hazards and appropriate actions.

indicators.title: Household disaster preparedness levels
indicators.description: Percentage of households in the affected area that have completed practical disaster preparedness actions such as having emergency plans, kits, and insurance.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Household preparedness survey measuring completion of key preparedness actions, administered annually to a stratified random sample of affected households.

indicators.title: Updated risk management plans in place
indicators.description: Number and quality of local emergency management and risk reduction plans that have been updated to reflect lessons learned and revised risk assessments.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Review of local government and community organisation emergency management plans against quality criteria, conducted at 12-month intervals post-disaster.
